home.heading: Play together, live
home.tagline: Host a quiz on the big screen and let everyone join on their phone. No account, no server: devices talk to each other directly.
home.hostHint: Pick one of your sets and get a room code.
home.joinHint: Enter the code shown by the host.
home.invalidCode: A code has 6 letters or digits.
home.noSets: You have no sets yet. Create one first.
home.how1: The host opens a room and shares a 6-character code or QR code.
home.how2: Players open the link and pick a name and avatar. Everything runs peer-to-peer over WebRTC.
home.how3: Works on the same Wi-Fi and on most internet connections. The host's browser keeps score; players see live standings.
home.how4: Nothing is uploaded: only the public signalling relays help devices find each other.

classic.name: Classic Live
classic.desc: Race: be the first to answer {{count}} questions correctly in a row. A wrong answer sends you back to the start.

match.name: Multiplayer Match
match.desc: Everyone gets the same board of tiles. Match terms and definitions as fast as you can.

blast.name: Blast live
blast.desc: Answer as many questions as you can in {{seconds}} seconds. Speed earns extra points.

study.name: Study with friends
study.desc: Everyone answers the same questions together. Afterwards you see which terms the group missed most.

host.chooseTypeSub: Play with friends and find out which terms your group missed most often.

host.playAlongHint: Answer on this screen as a player too.
host.relayDown: No relay reachable. Players may not be able to find this room.
